name: Thiphania
source: Thiphania is a child prodigy and a great scholar. She could very well be one of the smartest people in the world but unfortunately, her fame has gotten to her head and she's extremely arrogant and prideful. She's the first person who will NOT go peacefully and will cause massive troubles if you try and turn her away.
